entry.title: Show HN: Cluttersignal, a second opinion on any email or link you get (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: I'm building Clutterstrike. The first product is called Cluttersignal, which is a browser extension that gives users a second opinion on whether or not an email or link is safe or malicious without enterprise tooling right from their browser. I built it to help people identify scams and phishing attempts, even as those evolve into more sophisticated attacks and ideated it around both my parents, my family and friends, and colleagues. The hardest thing I am working on now is trying to find more edge cases that would slip by the screen to reduce the chance of false negatives as much as possible. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49972370 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

entry.title: Show HN: Cold B2B email should be free (FlyHedwig) (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Until recently I didn't understand what cold email really was and I accepted its price as one of those "it is what it is" things. But exploring the topic, I realised that there is no reason someone should have to pay for cold email, so I built FlyHedwig. With FlyHedwig you can manage hundreds of email addresses, schedule sending times, import lists, get stats... all the good stuff. Ah, and it's got some cool AI-classification and draft built in. If you work with cold email, I'd love to hear your thoughts! And if you like the project, as it's OSS, starring it would help it reach more people and encourage me to continue to improve it! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49972233 Points: 1 # Comments: 4

entry.title: Ask HN: Are there AI models for generating sounds based on a text and reference? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: I've been having a hard time finding a solution. Is there really no commercialized model that I can feed in a reference sound and text instruction and get another sound out? Right now having a multimodal inputs to image or text output is a commodotized, solved problem. IE you can put a prompt for some image and use a reference image to guide the model on what you want. After all, a picture is worth a thousand words right? Ive also used a text and audio input in order to get a text description or classification out. I cannot for the life of me find a solution for Audio + text -> Audio My usecase is that I'm trying to generate new sound effects based on a source that doesn't have that many clean examples and thought this would be just another solved workflow but I'm not finding much. Tried elevenlabs SFX but it's only text->audio and without the reference, it's hard to guide with just text and recreate a sound with any accuracy. I tried the Stable Audio 3 model which is supposed to do what I want but the results were terrible. This modality seems to be stuck where image generation was in 2016. Is there something else or is this just not a common need? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49972125 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
